title: Initial observation in the search machine
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, let $x$ be a finite binary input, and let $d$ be a configuration whose state is the recording machine's initial state. Let $r$ be the rank determined by the symbol under the input head and the symbols under the first $k$ work-tape heads of $d$. Starting the search machine in its observe control state, after two steps it is in the state carrying rank $r$, with the summary-tape head advanced by two cells. It does not reach the done state at either earlier time, and through time two its input-head position, tape contents, and output are unchanged, while all work-tape heads other than the summary-tape head stay fixed.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ is in the recording machine's initial state
